## Activity

East City Eye Clinic completed 109 captures during June 2021. This represents the recorded activity for the reporting period. The available activity information indicates that imaging was undertaken at the clinic and submitted for review. Staff should continue to maintain the established process for capture, submission and follow-up so that activity records remain complete and can be reviewed consistently.

## Image quality

Of the captured images, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.8 per cent. This result should be monitored as part of routine quality assurance. Where an image cannot be graded, the relevant cause should be considered and any recurring equipment or technique issues should be recorded. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk.

## Grading

A total of 24 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 days. This measure should continue to be reviewed alongside activity and image-quality information, as it provides an indication of the time taken for results to progress through grading. The reported figures provide a concise view of the clinic’s performance for June 2021 and identify the areas requiring ongoing operational attention.
